skills.name: Shepherd the Afflicted
skills.text: Add 1 to the maximum distance other friendly fighters can move if they started the move within 6" of this fighter.

skills.name: Demonic Conduit
skills.text: Once per battle, when a friendly *Demon* fighter would be set up from reserve, they can instead be set up within 3" of this fighter, not engaged in melee with any enemy fighters.

skills.name: Rite of Contagion
skills.text:
Once per battle, if this fighter is not engaged, this fighter can use the following bonus action:

**Rite of Contagion [Bonus Action]:** Each enemy fighter within 12" of this fighter must pass a Willpower test else suffer 1 point of damage and be *poisoned* (See the Poison weapon trait).

skills.name: Last Rites
skills.text: Each time another fighter is taken down within 6" of this fighter, this fighter can heal 1 life point.

skills.name: Unholy Sermon
skills.text:
Once per battle, if this fighter is not engaged, this fighter can use the following bonus action:

**Unholy Sermon [Bonus Action]:** Until the end of the round, add 1 to Attack rolls for melee attacks made by friendly fighters while they are within 6" of this fighter.

skills.name: The Black Benediction
skills.text: Subtract 1 from the Damage and Critical Damage values of weapons while they target this fighter (to a minimum of 1).
